headline: Weathered Expanse Boils as Hollow Fight Quickens
war_summary: Three hours have turned the wires over to Weathered Expanse, now reporting fourteen changes in two hours and sixty-four in the day around Spirit Watch, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, holding at four Warden, three Colonial and two neutral amid more than seven thousand Colonial and eight thousand Warden casualties in the day. Marban Hollow quickens behind it with eight in two and thirty-five in the day around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, now listed at one Warden, six Colonial and one neutral. Linn Mercy stirs again with five late changes at Outwich Ranch at one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral, while Kuura Strand posts five in two around Faden Point and Menneen at two Warden and four Colonial, and Pari Peak four in two and eighteen in the day around Pariah at four Colonial and one neutral. Gutter and Olavis Wake have gone quiet in the last two hours despite seventy-three and fourteen changes in the day, Gutter now shown wholly Colonial. Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle still show heavy daily losses without a recorded change, and Stlican Shelf adds two late changes at Breaker Town.
